final:

- The only "gateway rollback" message in the workspace is from leo.park in #deploy-queue: *"The gateway rollback runbook still needs a second reviewer before Friday."*

If you actually meant Leo's message, I can set the #deploy-queue topic to "Post-release monitoring" — just say the word.
